create_transformer_model: create a JAX LLAMA2-like Transformer model with configurable dimensions, layers, and attention heads
build_rotary_embeddings: build rotary positional embeddings using precomputed cosine and sine frequency matrices for sequence length
apply_attention_mechanism: apply grouped multiquery attention with causal masking and dropout to transformer input tensors
configure_feedforward_network: configure a SwiGLU or GEGLU feedforward network with configurable hidden dimension and weight initialization
run_conditional_inference: run conditional transformer inference with AdaLN modulation on input embeddings and output logits
